classification: Completed fixed-budget sampler/cutoff comparison; no added trajectories
primary_gate_scope: combined_registered_pass combines the registered paired cutoff interval, recorded primitive-stage and selected saved-state scoring gates. CDF contract and mechanism readbacks are separate. These checks do not establish complete simulator, all-state, dissipative-channel or hardware accuracy.

metric_definition.quantity: Cutoff 5120 minus 4096 mean logical fidelity, paired by trajectory within each of six cardinal states
metric_definition.direction: Every interval must lie wholly within [-0.01, 0.01]
metric_definition.denominator: 128 independent trajectories per cardinal state; six states; 768 per job and arm. The same exogenous bank is shared across registered conditions, cutoffs and samplers.
metric_definition.aggregation: Each cardinal state receives equal weight
metric_definition.uncertainty: Pointwise state-stratified normal-approximation 95% CI: mean plus or minus 1.95996398454 paired SE. These are not simultaneous intervals. Separate event intervals use fixed-n Clopper-Pearson with Bonferroni correction.

variance_comparison.scope: Descriptive paired-cutoff variance only; no variance-ratio interval or proof of absence of physical cutoff bias.

preflight.scope: Estimates/preflight only; parent also samples child RSS and enforces deadline. Accelerate thread count remains environment-requested.

density_reservation.scope: Sampled process-tree RSS; full4GiB reservation persists between v7/v8.

terminal_status.thread_scope: Accelerate count environment-requested, not independently verified.

interpretation_limits: Both samplers use the same fixed budget of 768 trajectories per job and arm. Primary mean-fidelity intervals provide pointwise stratified normal-approximation 95% coverage, not simultaneous coverage.
The changed common-random-number mapping preserves the declared finite-instrument marginals within the numerical CDF budget. It does not reproduce the historical joint counterfactual draw mapping.
CDF interpolation and tail terms are analytic; the 5e-12 floating-point allowance is an unproved engineering allowance.
Variance reduction does not prove zero true cutoff bias, hardware accuracy, all-state coverage or generality beyond four registered conditions, six cardinal inputs and eight cycles.
The historical summaries with 512 trajectories per state and larger unrun grids remain unchanged.
